headline: US Lawmakers Propose Bipartisan Ban on DUV Chipmaking Tools to Key Chinese Firms
summary: This bipartisan proposal to ban exports of DUV lithography and etching tools to leading Chinese semiconductor fabs like Huawei and SMIC marks a significant escalation in the US-China tech conflict. If enacted, it would severely curtail China's ability to produce even mature-node chips, further disrupting global semiconductor supply chains and intensifying geopolitical tensions over technological supremacy.
